notes: User-facing configuration defaults. Persisted at runtime in chrome.storage.sync; this file is the seed.

storeNumber.purpose: Default store the user works at. Null so packaged builds ship without a specific store baked in; user enters in popup and it persists to chrome.storage.sync after first use.

date.purpose: Default date for the search. Computed at popup-open time, local timezone.
date.notes: Compute via new Date() in popup, format to match what CaseVisibility's date input accepts (UNKNOWN until recon).

recipientEmail.purpose: Default recipient address for the closing email draft.
recipientEmail.notes: User enters in popup; saved to chrome.storage.sync after first use.

afternoonCutoff.purpose: Rule for including an associate in the closing list.
afternoonCutoff.notes: User can adjust both thresholds in popup settings.

emailSubjectTemplate.purpose: Subject line for the closing email draft.

emailBodyHeader.value:
Closing List for Store {store} on {date}

Format: Name: schedule: notes
emailBodyHeader.purpose: Header inserted at the top of the editable email body before associate lines.
